title: Serene Meadows
subtitle: A premium gated community of 71 thoughtfully planned 2 and 3 BHK residences, created for families, second-home buyers and investors seeking a well-connected address in Goa.
overviewBody:
Serene Meadows is an exclusive community of 71 premium residences comprising 63 spacious 2 BHK apartments and 8 elegant 3 BHK apartments. Each home is planned to balance generous living spaces, practical layouts and a sense of everyday ease.

Within the secure gated community, residents can enjoy a signature swimming pool, a well-equipped gymnasium, landscaped gardens and shared spaces designed to bring comfort, wellness and connection into daily life.
highlights: Prime Location at Kadamba Plateau, Goa
RERA registered [INSERT GOA RERA REGISTRATION NUMBER]
settingBody: From Serene Meadows, the character of nearby Old Goa unfolds through views of historic churches, rolling green hills and foliage-filled landscapes. Mornings arrive with soft light across the horizon, while evenings bring a slower rhythm home. It is a setting where Goa's heritage and natural landscape remain part of everyday life.
lifestyleBody: The double-height atrium creates a welcoming centre for the community, while the swimming pool, gymnasium and landscaped areas make space for movement, rest and time together. A community hall with a pantry and common washroom adds a practical setting for celebrations, meetings and shared occasions.
amenities: Community hall with pantry and common washroom
Power backup for lifts and common areas
connectivityIntro: Serene Meadows places healthcare, education, shopping, transport links and Panaji within convenient driving distance.
